common.loadFailed: Couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.

errors.contentBlocked: This breaks our Community Guidelines and can't be saved.
errors.tooManyReports: You've sent several reports recently. Try again later.
errors.signedOut: You're signed out. Sign in and try again.

home.dataSaverHint: Plays lower quality video to use less mobile data
home.logoutMessage: You can sign back in at any time.

language.restartMessage: {{language}} reads in the other direction, so the app will restart to change its layout.
language.restartNote: Switching between a right-to-left language such as Arabic and a left-to-right one such as English restarts the app, because the layout direction can only change at startup.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.privateHint: When your account is private, only people you approve can follow you and see your videos. People who already follow you are not removed.
privacy.friendsMeaning: Friends are people you follow who also follow you back.

who.hint_friends: People you follow who follow you back
who.hint_following: Anyone you follow. Kept from your earlier choice.
who.question_message: Who can send you direct messages?
who.question_comment: Who can comment on your videos?
who.question_tag: Who can tag or mention you?
who.note_message: People who can't message you can still see your public profile. Blocked accounts can never message you.
who.note_comment: This applies to all of your videos. You can change it at any time.
who.note_tag: You can change this at any time.
who.friendsUnavailable: The Friends option isn't switched on for your account yet. Your previous choice has been kept. Please try again after the next update.

location.title: Location sharing
location.switchHint: Only available to people aged 18 and over. Turning it off deletes your stored location.
location.friendsHint: People you follow who follow you back
location.note: You can turn location sharing off at any time.
location.adultOnly: Location sharing is only available to people aged 18 and over.
location.birthBody: Location sharing is for people aged 18 and over. Enter your date of birth to continue. It is never shown to anyone and can't be changed later.

closeFriends.title: Close friends
closeFriends.note: No one is told they're on this list. You can change it at any time.
closeFriends.emptySub: Follow people to add them to your close friends.

blocked.title: Blocked accounts
blocked.note: People you block can't find your profile, see your videos or message you. They aren't told that you blocked them.
blocked.emptySub: You can block anyone from their profile.
blocked.mutual: This account has blocked you too
blocked.confirmBody: {{name}} will be able to see your profile and message you again.

restricted.title: Restricted accounts
restricted.note: A restricted person isn't told. Their comments on your videos are only visible to them, and they can't message you.
restricted.emptySub: Comments from restricted accounts are only shown to them.

muted.title: Muted accounts
muted.note: Muting hides someone's videos from your feed without unfollowing them. They aren't told.
muted.emptySub: Videos from muted accounts don't appear in your feed.

hiddenWords.title: Hidden words
hiddenWords.note: Comments containing these words or phrases are hidden from you. The person who wrote them isn't told.
hiddenWords.addFailed: Couldn't add the word. Try again.
hiddenWords.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the word. Try again.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.note: Choose what we tell you about. Security alerts are always sent.

password.title: Change password
password.forgotBody: We'll sign you out. On the sign-in screen, tap "Forgot password" and we'll email you a code to set a new one.
password.sameAsOld: Choose a password different from your current one
password.othersSignedOut: After the change, your other devices are signed out.
password.doneBody: Use your new password the next time you sign in.

email.title: Change email
email.note: We'll send a six-digit code to the new address. Your email doesn't change until you enter it.
email.oldCodeLead: Now enter the code we sent to your current address
email.pendingBody: Check both inboxes. Your email changes once both addresses are confirmed.

devices.title: Login activity
devices.note: These devices have signed in to your account. If you don't recognise one, remove it and then change your password.
devices.emptySub: Your device appears here after you reopen the app.
devices.removeBody: {{device}} will be removed from your login activity. To be sure it's signed out, change your password too.
devices.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the device. Try again.

data.title: Download your data
data.note: Request a copy of your profile, videos, comments, messages and activity. We'll prepare the file, and it will appear here when it's ready.
data.requestFailed: Couldn't send the request. Try again.

status.title: Deactivate or delete account
status.intro: You can hide your account for a while or delete it permanently. Choose what suits you.
status.deactivate1: Your profile, videos and comments are hidden from everyone.
status.deactivate2: Nothing is deleted, and everything comes back as it was.
status.deactivate3: Just sign in again to reactivate it.
status.deactivateConfirm: Your account will be hidden from everyone until you sign in again. You'll be signed out now.
status.delete1: Your videos, comments, messages and followers are deleted.
status.delete2: You have 30 days to change your mind before anything is deleted.
status.irreversible: After 30 days this can't be undone
status.deleteLose1: All your videos and comments will be deleted.
status.deleteLose2: Your chats and messages will be deleted.
status.deleteLose3: Your followers and the people you follow will be lost.
status.deleteLose4: Someone else may take your username.
status.deleteLoseEarnings: Your unwithdrawn creator earnings ({{n}} 💎) will be lost. Withdraw them before you delete your account.
status.deleteWhen: Your account is deleted 30 days from now. Until then it is hidden from everyone. If you sign in during those 30 days, the deletion is cancelled and everything is kept.
status.deleteConfirm: Your account and everything in it will be deleted in 30 days. You'll be signed out now. Sign in within 30 days to cancel.
status.pendingTitle: Your account is scheduled for deletion
status.pendingBody_one: {{count}} day left. You can cancel the deletion now and keep everything.
status.pendingBody_other: {{count}} days left. You can cancel the deletion now and keep everything.
status.keepCta: Cancel deletion and keep my account
status.cancelledBody: Your account is safe and nothing will be deleted.
status.deactivatedBody: It's hidden from everyone. Reactivate it to show your profile, videos and comments again.
status.appealRowHint: Ask us to review a suspension or removed content

activity.title: Your activity
activity.noComments: You haven't written any comments yet
activity.deleteBody: It will be removed from the video for everyone.
activity.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the comment. Try again.

report.title: Report a problem
report.note: Describe what happened in as much detail as you can. We attach your device type and app version automatically.
report.sentBody: We'll review it and reply in the app. You can see the reply under Contact us.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.note: Choose whatever suits you. A report from inside the app is quickest, because it reaches us with your device details.
contact.promise: We review every report within 24 hours, remove content that breaks the rules and close the account that posted it.

edit.cameraDenied: Allow FLYP to use the camera in your device settings to take a profile photo.
edit.photoFailed: Couldn't use that photo. Try another one.
edit.photoBlocked: This photo breaks our Community Guidelines. Choose a different one.
edit.privateNote: This information is private and never shown on your profile.
edit.saveFailed: Couldn't save your changes. Try again.
edit.discardBody: Your changes haven't been saved. They'll be lost if you leave now.

gate.welcomeBack: Welcome back — your account is active again
gate.deletionCancelled: Welcome back — your account deletion was cancelled and your account is active again

appeals.title: Appeal a decision
appeals.intro: If you think we got something wrong, tell us why. A person reviews every appeal, and you'll get a notification with the decision.
appeals.noneSub: Your account has no suspensions or removed content.
appeals.limitReached: You have {{n}} appeals under review. You can send another once one is decided.

form.title: Your appeal
form.label: Why should we review this?
form.placeholder: Explain what happened and why you think the decision was wrong.
form.hint: A person will read this. Be specific and polite.
form.sent: Appeal sent. We'll notify you of the decision.
form.missing: This can no longer be appealed.

errors.appeal_not_eligible: This can no longer be appealed.
errors.appeal_already_open: You already have an appeal under review for this.
errors.appeal_already_decided: An appeal for this has already been decided.
errors.appeal_limit_open: You have 3 appeals under review. Wait for a decision before sending another.
errors.appeal_reason_required: Write a reason for your appeal.
errors.appeals_unavailable: Appeals aren't available yet. Try again later.

banned.title: Your account is suspended
banned.body: You can't use FLYP while your account is suspended. If you think this is a mistake, appeal and a person will review it.
banned.appealOpen: Your appeal is under review. We'll notify you of the decision.
banned.lifted: Your account is no longer suspended
